host.title: UniFi Host
host.description: IP or hostname of your UniFi OS console/gateway (e.g. 10.1.0.1) or self-hosted controller

port.title: Port
port.description: HTTPS port: 443 for UniFi OS consoles, 8443 for a self-hosted UniFi Network Application

site.title: Site Name
site.description: UniFi site name — visible in the URL of your controller dashboard

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to fetch WAN stats. 5 seconds is the recommended minimum.

rejectUnauthorized.title: Verify SSL Certificate
rejectUnauthorized.description: Disable for self-signed certificates (standard for local controllers)

showLatency.title: Show WAN Latency Sensor
showLatency.description: Adds a "WAN Latency" light sensor showing internet latency in ms (1 ms = 1 lux), as reported by UniFi's internet health check. Uses the existing poll, no extra requests.

showSpeedTest.title: Show Speed Test Result Sensors
showSpeedTest.description: Adds "Speed Test Download" and "Speed Test Upload" light sensors showing the result of UniFi's last internet speed test in Mbps (1 Mbps = 1 lux). They change only when UniFi runs a speed test. Uses the existing poll, no extra requests.

showClientCount.title: Show Connected Clients Sensor
showClientCount.description: Adds a "Connected Clients" light sensor showing how many Wi-Fi and wired clients (including guests) are connected (1 client = 1 lux). Uses the existing poll, no extra requests.

showDeviceStatus.title: Show UniFi Devices Sensor
showDeviceStatus.description: Adds a "UniFi Devices" contact sensor that is closed while all adopted access points, switches and gateways are connected, and opens when any of them goes offline. Uses the existing poll, no extra requests.
